rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for giving someone a warning or calling a risk to their attention.

example.english: I alert you to remember to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我提醒你聽日記得帶遮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai4 sing2 nei5 ting1 jat6 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this when the warning is strong, serious, or carries an implied threat of consequences.

example.english: I alert you that if you do that again, you’ll be fired.
example.traditional: 我警告你，再咁樣做就會畀人炒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ging2 gou3 nei5 zoi3 gam3 joeng2 zou6 zau6 wui5 bei2 jan4 caau2
